name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.

Kira goes with exactly two of Boyd, Geography, and Workshop.
Hale goes with at least one of Geography, Music, or Mona.
Noah goes with either Boyd or Carver.
